crossRefs.note: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
translations.bsb: those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
translations.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.asv: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
